terms.description: Facts with the same value across every observed instance.
One point-in-time occurrence of a logical item.
The process identifier assigned by macOS for this running instance.
The process identifier of the process that launched this instance.
Physical memory attributed to the process at observation time.
Software that installs and tracks other software packages.
Software that executes programs written for a language or platform.
A coordinated set of tools used to build or run software.
The reverse-domain identifier an application bundle declares so macOS and other software can distinguish it from other applications.
A macOS directory with a defined internal structure that Finder presents as a single application.
Data whose owning tool can recreate it; this is not permission to delete it.
A declaration that may start software automatically.
A fact HAL directly read from an allowed source.
A value computed deterministically from observed facts.
A reasoned relationship that retains uncertainty and supporting evidence.
A choice made explicitly by the user rather than observed by HAL.
